prompt.prompt_en: Create a documentary photograph of an unmistakably adult woman, a survey astronomer on a municipal observatory rooftop at dawn. In a chest-up, nearly frontal portrait, she draws an azimuth line from a brass transit telescope toward the bright morning star while steadying a transparent city-map overlay across a weathered atlas; a mechanical chronometer, compass, penciled coordinate grid, and wind-lifted survey sheets keep the task readable. Her expression is calm and neutral, all hair is pinned away from both temples, cheekbones, jaw corners, and chin, and the complete hairline temple cheek jaw and chin perimeter remains visible. Across that outline, the upper and middle face are moderately longer than wide; the cheek region is wider than the jaw; the jaw narrows more strongly and smoothly into a small chin with a softly rounded tip. Here literal contour evidence replaces the culture-scoped label at runtime. Use distortion-controlled portrait perspective, balanced bilateral outline visibility, and soft side-to-front dawn light that models every facial landmark. The supplied image guides only broadly visible adult appearance; this specified facial geometry takes precedence over its silhouette.
